reading: The sketch lays out a sales-pipeline page: a full-width header bar labelled 'Pipeline', a toolbar row underneath for the 'Q4 New business' board with owner/close-date filters and a '+ New deal' button, a large kanban board with four stage columns (Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Won) full of deal cards, and a right-hand deal-detail panel for 'Acme Corp' with its activity feed and action buttons. A run-wide note sets the page to a pale grey (#f5f6f8) background with Helvetica type and dark navy text throughout.
